name: Voxel World Generation with Perlin Noise
aliases: Voxel Density Field Generation with Perlin Noise
definition: A compute shader technique that generates a voxel-based world by evaluating fractal Brownian motion (fBm) noise against a threshold to determine voxel existence and material type (stone, dirt, grass).
summary: Voxel World Generation with Perlin Noise creates 3D voxel worlds by mapping fractal noise to discrete material layers based on vertical position, unlike continuous scalar fields.
